# SukuuX Ghana Schools Explorer — data guide

The site presents 10,795 Ghana school directory rows representing 10,503 unique institution IDs, 10,229 populated phone entries and 8,865 approximate coordinates. Point-in-polygon processing assigns 8,863 coordinate records to current districts. The integrated administrative map contains Ghana (ADM0), 16 current regions (ADM1) and 261 districts (ADM2).

Canonical domain: https://search.sukuux.com/

## Stable URL patterns
- /school/<school-name>-<institution-id>/
- /region/<region-name>/
- /district/<district-name>/
- /schools/page/<number>/

## Boundary provenance
The baseline is OCHA/HDX Ghana COD-AB. Guan District is supplemented from OpenStreetMap relation 13804589, removed from Hohoe Municipal and assigned to Oti Region.

## Limitations
Coordinates are usually representative points for a named town, village or locality and should not be treated as exact campus coordinates. The site preserves the source directory region separately from the current coordinate-derived region and district.
